page.overview:
Who is Kyojuro Rengoku?

Kyojuro Rengoku is the Flame Hashira who fights beside Tanjiro on the Mugen Train and faces Upper Rank Akaza.

Also known as: Rengoku, Flame Hashira, Kyojurou Rengoku.
